_meta.description: Translator-context sidecar for auth.profile. The /profile route shown when a user picks 'Profile' from the dashboard avatar menu. Today it is a deliberate 'Coming soon' placeholder (BUG-AUTH-3a); the real profile editor is a future story.
_meta.audience: Authenticated workspace users who clicked 'Profile' from the avatar menu in the dashboard sidebar.
_meta.tone: Calm, neutral, transparent. Acknowledge the gap without apologising. No marketing language. No exclamation marks. Short sentences.

title._use: H1 at the top of /profile. Mirrors the menu item the user clicked so the destination feels intentional. Keep to one or two words.

subtitle._use: One supporting sentence under the H1. Names the eventual scope (account / preferences / notifications) so users understand what 'profile' will mean here. Keep to one sentence.

badge._use: Lumia DS Badge label inside the placeholder card. Visible status pill. Keep ≤ 14 chars after translation so it fits a single-line badge on mobile.

heading._use: Card heading announcing the placeholder state. Conveys 'this destination is real but the editor isn't ready'. Keep at most six words.

body._use: Single paragraph explaining what will eventually live here AND how users get changes today (via workspace owners / support). Important: do NOT promise specific dates.

supportLabel._use: Visible label on the 'Contact support' link. Points at mailto:support@xynes.com. The 'opens in new tab' affordance is rendered as a separate sr-only string in code — translators should NOT add 'opens in new tab' here.

backLabel._use: Visible label on the secondary 'Back to dashboard' link. Returns the user to /dashboard/apps (the default landing destination).
